ruleDefinitions.name: Anydesk Remote Access Software Service Installation
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the installation of the anydesk software service. Which could be an indication of anydesk abuse if you the software isn't already used. Note: Unmapped fields: Provider_Name, ServiceName, ImagePath

sequences.query: ((Provider_Name = "Service\ Control\ Manager" AND event_id = 7045) AND ((ServiceName = RGX(".*AnyDesk.*") AND ServiceName = RGX(".*Service.*")) OR ImagePath = RGX(".*AnyDesk.*")))
